### DistributeAllInput {#DistributeAllInput}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">splits.DistributeAllInput</code></div>

```ts sdk-signature
interface DistributeAllInput {

    address?: string;
  };
  principalSplit?: SplitParamsInput & {
    address?: string;
  };
  recipients?: string[];
  includeRaf?: boolean;
  minWithdraw?: bigint;
  distributor?: string;
  from?: string;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>ovm?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>rewardSplit?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./core#SplitParamsInput">SplitParamsInput</a> &amp; { address?: string }</span> | The split params; `address` defaults to the OVM's matching recipient. |
| <code>principalSplit?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./core#SplitParamsInput">SplitParamsInput</a> &amp; { address?: string }</span> |  |
| <code>recipients?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string[]</span> | Whose balances to withdraw; default every recipient of the splits (the Obol RAF included). |
| <code>includeRaf?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> | Whether the Obol RAF address (the chain's `rafRecipient`) is withdrawn (default true). Withdrawing it is permissionless and costs the recipients nothing. With `false` it is left out of the withdrawal set, and RAF_LEFT_IN_WAREHOUSE (info) reports what stays in the Warehouse. |
| <code>minWithdraw?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | Skip a leg moving less than this (wei, default 1). |
| <code>distributor?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | Receives split distribution incentives; default the sender. |
| <code>from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | The sender, for the pause rules; default the wallet account. |

</div>

### SkipReason {#SkipReason}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">type</span> <code class="sdk-qual">splits.SkipReason</code></div>

Why a leg is left out: `nothing` (0 after the 1 wei kept), `dust` (below

and the sender cannot bypass it).

type SkipReason = 'nothing' | 'dust' | 'paused';

### SplitsModule {#SplitsModule}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">splits.SplitsModule</code></div>

The splits module bound to a client context.

```ts sdk-signature
interface SplitsModule {
  percent: typeof percent;
  formatPercent: typeof formatPercent;
  splitParams: typeof splitParams;
  predictSplit: (input: PredictSplitInput) => Promise<{
    address: Address;
    exists: boolean;
  }>;
  prepareCreateSplit: (
    input: CreateSplitInput,
  ) => Promise<Prepared<'createSplit'>>;
  getSplit: (
    input: GetSplitInput,
  ) => Promise<SplitInfo | null>;
  prepareDistributeAll: (
    input: DistributeAllInput,
  ) => Promise<Prepared<'distributeAll'>>;
  previewDistributeAll: (
    input: DistributeAllInput,
  ) => Promise<PreviewResult<DistributeAllPreview>>;
  distributionFromReceipt: (
    receipt: DistributionReceipt,
    options?: {
      ovm?: string;
    },
  ) => DistributionResult;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>percent</code> | <span class="sdk-type">typeof percent</span> |  |
| <code>formatPercent</code> | <span class="sdk-type">typeof formatPercent</span> |  |
| <code>splitParams</code> | <span class="sdk-type">typeof splitParams</span> |  |
| <code>predictSplit</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#PredictSplitInput">PredictSplitInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;{ address: Address; exists: boolean }&gt;</span> | The deterministic (CREATE2) address of a SplitV2 split for these params, owner and salt, and whether it exists already. |
| <code>prepareCreateSplit</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#CreateSplitInput">CreateSplitInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'createSplit'&gt;&gt;</span> | Creates a SplitV2 split from recipients and shares (parts per million). Already deployed at the predicted address: SPLIT_ALREADY_EXISTS (use its `address`; nothing to send). |
| <code>getSplit</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: <a href="#GetSplitInput">GetSplitInput</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#SplitInfo">SplitInfo</a> &#124; null&gt;</span> | null when the address is not a SplitV2 split; throws for read failures. |
| <code>prepareDistributeAll</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#DistributeAllInput">DistributeAllInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'distributeAll'&gt;&gt;</span> | Distributes an OVM, the SplitV2 splits behind its recipients and the recipients' Warehouse balances in one Multicall3 transaction. Splits must be passed with the exact params they were created with (SPLIT_PARAMS_MISMATCH, SPLIT_PARAMS_REQUIRED). [`ovm.prepareDistribute`](../ovm.md#prepareDistribute) is the OVM alone. |
| <code>previewDistributeAll</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#DistributeAllInput">DistributeAllInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#PreviewResult">PreviewResult</a>&lt;<a href="#DistributeAllPreview">DistributeAllPreview</a>&gt;&gt;</span> | The reads and amounts of `prepareDistributeAll` without a transaction. |
| <code>distributionFromReceipt</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( receipt: <a href="#DistributionReceipt">DistributionReceipt</a>, options?: { ovm?: string }, ) =&gt; <a href="#DistributionResult">DistributionResult</a></span> |  |
